archetypes.name: dyn-commit-route
archetypes.rationale: Commit routing now owns durable stall state and stdout envelopes across three hot paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new implement commit-route helper and its Step 5 resume integration. Focus on stdout envelope cardinality, rc semantics, durable stall seeding, and whether resume handoff can accidentally relaunch review-and-fix after a commit-phase stall. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
